CO2_Impact_Index.name: CO2 Impact Index
CO2_Impact_Index.description: Standardized sustainability score representing environmental impact of packaging material
CO2_Impact_Index.interpretation: Higher value indicates lower environmental impact and better sustainability

Cost_Efficiency_Index.name: Cost Efficiency Index
Cost_Efficiency_Index.description: Economic feasibility score considering material cost, weight, recyclability, and durability
Cost_Efficiency_Index.interpretation: Higher value indicates more cost-effective packaging material

Material_Suitability_Score.name: Material Suitability Score
Material_Suitability_Score.description: Compatibility score measuring how suitable a material is for a specific product category
Material_Suitability_Score.interpretation: Higher value indicates better suitability for target product
